cwe_content.cwe: CWE-79,Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

candidate.Reason: Processes STYLE tag content but relies on external CSS scanner for proper encoding. If the CSS scanner doesn't properly encode malicious content, XSS can occur through CSS injection.
Processes all attributes including style attributes which could contain malicious CSS content leading to XSS if not properly encoded

Directly processes CSS content from STYLE tags. If the CssScanner doesn't properly sanitize CSS content (including expression(), javascript:, etc.), it can lead to XSS vulnerabilities when the content is rendered

Processes inline style attributes. Relies on CssScanner to properly sanitize CSS content. If the scanner fails to detect and neutralize malicious CSS expressions, XSS can occur through style attribute injection
